findings.evidence: Phase 4 restates the script's capability contract (exit 0 prints attach or branch; exit 2 or other stdout is terminal; old gh prints branch) and then repeats the same 2.101 sort -V check the script already ran.
findings.fix: Keep only the command-specific outcome (when to skip render, the Mermaid fallback, and the warning text) and point the probe rules at skills/pr-diagrams/SKILL.md, which already states capability always exits 0 and that gh older than 2.101 selects branch.

findings.evidence: Exit 2, any other non-zero exit, or exit 0 with any other stdout stops the run before render as a terminal failure ... names the failing pr-diagrams.sh capability call. The bundled script's own help says capability prints attach or branch and always exits 0, and cmd_capability returns 0 after a failed, timed-out, or unparsable gh --version probe with stdout branch.
findings.fix: Follow the script: treat exit 0 with stdout branch as branch mode (including a failed probe), and reserve the terminal stop for the cases the script actually fails, exit 2 from a stray argument or an invalid PR_DIAGRAMS_MODE.

findings.evidence: argument-hint lists only --diagrams=none|mermaid|drawio, not the bare aliases the body treats as the only recognized option tokens.

Only in attach mode, run gh --version and compare the printed version with 2.101 using sort -V ... the check runs before rendering, even though capability already selected attach only when gh is at least 2.101.
findings.fix: Drop the second gh --version comparison in attach mode and trust the capability result the command just stored in MODE.

findings.evidence: A version older than 2.101, for example gh version 2.100.0, fails the check, restates a comparison the bundled capability probe already performs and documents.
findings.fix: Delete the worked example of the version comparison and record the removal; the mode decision stays in pr-diagrams.sh.

findings.evidence: Because $AD and the pointer file do not exist yet at this point, the phase 6 cleanup is skipped and nothing needs removing; "nothing else runs" refers to reads and PR writes.
findings.fix: State the phase-2 stop once: quote the tool error and skip cleanup because no scratch directory exists. Do not re-explain the same sentence.
